summary: Test-writing run for issue #39. Added a solver parity test target (SolverParityTests.swift) plus a vendored 12-scenario corpus fixture mirroring viamin/color_matching#111, replaying WeightedSquaredErrorScorer against every scenario including ties and exclusions. The corpus fixture was independently verified against the weighted-squared-error formula with a standalone Python check (all 12 scenarios self-consistent). Could not execute `swift test` in this environment (no Swift toolchain on Linux; this is a macOS/Xcode project), so the new test's pass/fail status under the real toolchain is not_run here and must be confirmed in CI/Xcode. The OpenAPI-client migration, disk-cache/offline-fallback preservation, and README documentation deliverables are implementation-phase work out of scope for this test-only run; existing ProfileColorCacheTests.swift already pins the cache/offline behavior that migration must preserve.
